items.title: Arcus Adds Stock Tokens and WETH as Perpetual Collateral
items.summary: The early-access feature uses automatic USDG loans at 50% initial loan-to-value, with non-USDG deposits capped at $20,000 per account.

items.title: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT
items.summary: One of the world's largest investment managers, BlackRock has filed for another bitcoin fund, marking its third tied to the asset.

items.title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

items.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
items.summary: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.
